notes.title: You Can Fly Anywhere as a Raven - VELKYN Devlog
notes.content:
A new devlog about the raven form in Velkyn is now available! Today, I’m introducing a very special feature: In the open world of Velkyn, you will always be able to transform into an astral raven.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/959d97ff089de12e6bb618b3e73876f296011a74.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Raven Form[/h2]

I’ve already fully implemented the raven into the game, and the transformation is working. If you're in the open world of Velkyn [b]and[/b] have activated at least one astral crystal, you can transform into a raven and explore the world from above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/6b14caaab2b9749860e28855db7fc31e3fca6439.jpg[/img]
The implementation of the raven took a lot of time and required extensive testing. When ascending, you lose speed, and when diving, you accelerate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/161331bf22905f6dd4af549d0b4f6b6ee85f1b61.jpg[/img]
The raven has an ability called "Flap" - with this, the raven takes a very strong wing flap and gains an instant speed boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/aeeab88dc2b10c1a62a8f1b170cdf9c4e6acf8d4.jpg[/img]

Once you unlock the raven form, you automatically unlock a new resource system called "Astral Power". Astral power is consumed during ascent and when using abilities. You can regenerate astral power by staying near astral crystals, collecting magical orbs while flying, or reaching high speed during a dive.

[h2]Today’s Devlog[/h2]

For everything else, please check out the new devlog on my YouTube channel. Besides many new game impressions, I’ve tried to make the video as entertaining as possible!

Enjoy the video!

[previewyoutube=memIpP6K-uE;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s the playlist if you want to check out the older VELKYN videos too: [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFDUICz5r1s0X7BI_JOCb7mMhEjFBXhoy]VELKYN Devlog Playlist[/url]


Best wishes,

Andy

notes.title: New VELKYN Minigame Devlog
notes.content:
A new VELKYN devlog has just been published! Today it's all about one of the minigames you can find throughout the world of VELKYN.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/cd58971c21e97128703c7c83cf18ebaea34cbe87.jpg[/img]
[h2]Golf Minigame[/h2]

You’ll encounter the golf minigame pretty early in the game. Minigames are located in so-called minigame huts. These huts are run by brothers from an old trade family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/70a5daba81f6191299461d3f99e026e4eec8783f.jpg[/img]
Each minigame offers its own type of challenge - and of course, there are useful items to win! In this dungeon-themed golf minigame, you need to be accurate, because you can only win if you sink the ball on every course in just a few strokes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/664c132f8a7f12cf73f7ce63a1cd75221ffbbf68.jpg[/img]
Minigames in VELKYN aren’t meant to be annoying or super grindy, but they should still provide a certain level of challenge as well as variety for the player. The minigames will be entirely optional - but that doesn’t mean the rewards aren’t worth mastering them for.

More screenshots:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/2480a40ce5621340da227cc38a526a7cdc75958c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/07a5e80786635658bfe18bdfa31b867854dc1ee0.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/76279f69c18850f9cc6b35ea3442c21b9e6c5d9b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/c045327526c5179ea4cf13d05c7f1294ddc4ab45.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Today’s Devlog[/h2]

In today’s devlog, I’m sharing info about the concept, gameplay, and also a few technical details. Either way, it’s an interesting video and I hope you’ll forgive me that it’s not about dungeons or combat today. ;-)

Enjoy the video!

[previewyoutube=SPrYPKc5gwI;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s the playlist if you want to check out the older VELKYN videos too: [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFDUICz5r1s0X7BI_JOCb7mMhEjFBXhoy]VELKYN Devlog Playlist[/url]


Best wishes,

Andy

notes.title: VELKYN Development Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the first development update for VELKYN on Steam! I'm excited to share that I'll be posting devlogs here on Steam, in addition to my YouTube channel. If you're reading this, there's a good chance you're interested in everything about VELKYN.

[h2]Catching Up[/h2]

Since the store page launched, a lot has happened in the game's development. In short, I've scrapped and restarted work on the old character controller and some other elements, which set back the timeline a bit. However, I'm thrilled to say that the new character movement feels fantastic and is designed to easily integrate more new mechanics!

I've documented the character controller development journey in a short mini-devlog series available in this YouTube playlist: [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFDUICz5r1s0X7BI_JOCb7mMhEjFBXhoy]VELKYN Devlog Playlist[/url]

[h2]The Vision[/h2]

While I can't share much about the story and world of VELKYN today, I can certainly talk about the gameplay! VELKYN is, and will remain, an action-adventure game with a strong focus on combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving. What’s new—and hopefully a standout feature—is my focus on smooth, exhilaration-inducing character movement! I want this exciting feel to extend not just to the open world, but also into dungeons and, most importantly, combat!

Think wall jumps, sliding or bar swinging combined with regular combat mechanics like air attacks, cool attack combos or dodge rolling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/f7a896cb4312f2d411e1c18692c17ef8225e66cf.jpg[/img]
A lot of these features are already in place in a basic form and, in my opinion, are already a lot of fun. This brings me to the next point.

[h2]The Biggest Update Yet: The COMBAT SYSTEM[/h2]

A new devlog video is out today on my YouTube channel showcasing the current state of VELKYN's combat system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/36bef491ea0d68cfe4783c9694eb2b827ec0c561.jpg[/img]
You’ll see various subsystems, different types of enemies, melee and ranged combat, blocking, dodging, parrying, and the movement (some might call it parkour) mechanics already mentioned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44804988/5e5435cc165e71fc9f2cb5ea77b82ee685564a69.jpg[/img]
Check out the video here: [url=https://youtu.be/1Ovz6tfxQyQ]COMBAT SYSTEM Devlog[/url]

[previewyoutube=1Ovz6tfxQyQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The combat system is meant to be enjoyable not just for me, but for you too! I’m eager to hear your feedback and your greatest wishes for the game! Nothing is set in stone, and I'm all ears!

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]

It’s too early for a detailed roadmap, but here are some ideas floating in my head for 2025:
[list][*] Making a small tech demo available (movement and/or combat)
[*] Preparing initial small-scale playtests
[*] Returning to larger Devlogs that showcase progress in the world and story[/list]

Wishing you all a peaceful holiday season and a fantastic start to the new year!


Best wishes,

Andy
